name.fil: Building or Structural Collapse (Pagguho ng Gusali o Istruktura)

lessons.en: Report wide cracks, sagging ceilings, and tilting walls to adults or school officials.
lessons.fil: I-report sa adult o school officials ang malalaking bitak, lumulubog na kisame, at tumatagilid na pader.

lessons.en: Stay out of damaged buildings until an engineer says they are safe.
lessons.fil: Huwag pumasok sa sirang gusali hangga't hindi sinasabi ng engineer na ligtas ito.

lessons.en: If trapped, cover your mouth and tap or whistle so rescuers can find you.
lessons.fil: Kapag naipit, takpan ang bibig at kumatok o pumito para mahanap ka ng rescuers.

question.en: Who should decide whether a damaged building is safe to use?
question.fil: Sino ang dapat magdesisyon kung ligtas gamitin ang sirang gusali?

choices.en: A licensed engineer or building official
choices.fil: Licensed na engineer o building official

explain.en: Only trained professionals can judge hidden structural damage.
explain.fil: Mga trained na propesyonal lang ang makakapagsabi kung may nakatagong pinsala sa istruktura.

question.en: What is the process of strengthening an existing building so it can better resist earthquakes and heavy loads?
question.fil: Ano ang tawag sa pagpapatibay ng lumang gusali para mas makayanan nito ang lindol at mabigat na karga?

explain.en: Retrofitting old schools and homes reduces collapse risk.
explain.fil: Nababawasan ng retrofitting ang panganib na gumuho ang mga lumang school at bahay.

question.en: Doors and windows that suddenly jam can be a sign that a building is shifting.
question.fil: Ang biglang pagsabit o hirap isara ng pinto at bintana ay puwedeng senyales na gumagalaw ang gusali.

explain.en: Jamming doors and windows can mean the frame has moved.
explain.fil: Kapag sumasabit ang pinto at bintana, puwedeng gumalaw na ang frame ng gusali.

question.en: The Philippine law that sets building safety standards is the National ____ Code.
question.fil: Ang batas ng Pilipinas na nagtatakda ng safety standards sa gusali ay ang National ____ Code.

explain.en: The National Building Code (PD 1096) sets rules for safe design and construction.
explain.fil: Ang National Building Code (PD 1096) ang nagtatakda ng mga patakaran para sa ligtas na disenyo at pagtatayo.

question.en: Match each building safety term with its meaning.
question.fil: Itugma ang bawat building safety term sa kahulugan nito.

pairs.en: Approval to build after plans are checked
pairs.fil: Pahintulot magtayo matapos suriin ang plano

pairs.en: Shows how much weight a structure can hold
pairs.fil: Nagsasabi kung gaano kabigat ang kayang dalhin ng istruktura

pairs.en: Fixing leaks, rust, and cracks early
pairs.fil: Maagang pag-aayos ng tagas, kalawang, at bitak

pairs.en: Vertical support that carries a building's weight
pairs.fil: Patayong suporta na nagdadala ng bigat ng gusali

explain.en: Permits, load limits, and maintenance prevent most collapses.
explain.fil: Napipigilan ng permit, load limits, at maintenance ang karamihan ng pagguho.

question.en: Name 3 warning signs that a structure may be unsafe.
question.fil: Magbigay ng 3 babala na puwedeng hindi na ligtas ang isang istruktura.

show.en: wide or growing cracks, sagging floors or ceilings, tilting walls, doors or windows that jam, creaking sounds, falling plaster, rusted exposed steel bars, leaking ceilings
show.fil: malaki o lumalaking bitak, lumulubog na sahig o kisame, tumatagilid na pader, pinto o bintanang sumasabit, lumalangitngit na tunog, nalalaglag na plaster, kinakalawang na bakal na nakalabas, tumutulong kisame

explain.en: Early reporting lets engineers check a structure before it fails.
explain.fil: Kapag maagang nai-report, masusuri ng engineer ang istruktura bago ito bumigay.

question.en: After an earthquake, your friend wants to run back into a cracked classroom to get her bag. What should you do?
question.fil: Pagkatapos ng lindol, gustong tumakbo pabalik ng kaibigan mo sa may-bitak na classroom para kunin ang bag niya. Ano ang dapat mong gawin?

choices.en: Tell her not to go in and inform the teacher
choices.fil: Sabihan siyang huwag pumasok at ipaalam sa teacher

choices.en: Hold the door open for her
choices.fil: Hawakan ang pinto para sa kanya

explain.en: The room must be inspected first. Belongings can be collected later if it is declared safe.
explain.fil: Kailangan munang suriin ang kuwarto. Makukuha rin ang gamit mamaya kapag idineklarang ligtas na.

question.en: You are trapped under debris. Arrange these steps in order.
question.fil: Naipit ka sa ilalim ng debris. Ayusin ang mga hakbang.

steps.en: Stay calm and keep still so debris does not shift
steps.fil: Manatiling kalmado at huwag masyadong gumalaw para hindi gumalaw ang debris

steps.en: Cover your nose and mouth with cloth
steps.fil: Takpan ang ilong at bibig gamit ang tela

steps.en: Tap on a pipe or wall, or blow a whistle
steps.fil: Kumatok sa tubo o pader, o pumito

steps.en: Listen for rescuers and answer their signals
steps.fil: Makinig sa rescuers at sagutin ang kanilang senyales

steps.en: Shout only when rescuers are close
steps.fil: Sumigaw lang kapag malapit na ang rescuers

explain.en: Tapping and whistles save energy and keep you from breathing in dust.
explain.fil: Nakakatipid ng lakas ang pagkatok at pagpito, at naiiwasan mong makalanghap ng alikabok.

scene.en: During a school program, the temporary stage creaks and shakes as more and more students crowd onto it.
scene.fil: Habang may school program, lumalangitngit at umuuga ang pansamantalang stage habang dumarami ang estudyanteng umaakyat dito.

choices.en: Tell a teacher right away so students can get off calmly in small groups
choices.fil: Sabihan agad ang teacher para mahinahong makababa ang mga estudyante nang paunti-unti

explain.en: Reducing the load quickly can prevent a collapse.
explain.fil: Ang mabilis na pagbawas ng bigat ay puwedeng makaiwas sa pagguho.
